6314.title: Please protect your personal information!
6314.desc:
Dear Doctor,
Recently, some individuals have been creating [abnormal] alliances, using announcements, emails, and impersonating leaders or R4 to invite doctors to join unofficial communities or obtain their private contact information. Communication outside the gaming platform may lead to privacy breaches or even personal property loss.
Please refrain from tapping or downloading content from unfamiliar links to prevent personal information leakage. Also, do not trust game information spread by unofficial personnel. Any changes or adjustments to the game will be announced through in-game notices, the official website, official Discord, Facebook, and other official channels.
If you encounter such illegal activities while playing, feel free to report them to us with relevant screenshots or recordings. Creating a harmonious gaming environment and resisting harmful information requires our joint effort!

Once you obtain Raven gear, visit the Raven Nest to equip it and significantly boost your Heroes' power.
Raven equipment can also be upgraded—Fuse 3 lower-tier pieces to create 1 higher-tier piece.
Build your Raven Workshop now and unleash your full potential in the vast skies!

Due to city planning and experience optimization, we have now removed the Research Lab 2. Your second Research Queue can still be used in the Lab, and all research queues will share the optimal speedup buff.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused and have returned the resources and speedup items used for upgrading Research Lab 2. An additional 24-hour building speedup is sent to you as compensation. In the future, we will develop new functional buildings for the vacant site. Please stay tuned for official announcements.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact us via [Avatar→Settings→Help]

Have a wonderful day.
Last Asylum Team

130004.title: First Time Joining Alliance
130004.desc:
Dear Doctor,
Congratulations on joining an alliance! From this moment forward, you no longer stand alone. To help you settle in and make the most of your alliance experience, here are a few helpful tips:
1. Donate to Alliance Technology daily. Alliance Technology is the backbone of alliance growth. Your contributions strengthen the alliance and earn you valuable Contribution Rewards in return.
2. Take part in alliance events. Alliance events offer rich rewards to boost your strength, and they're also a great way to fight alongside your teammates and build lasting bonds.
3. Relocate to the Alliance Assembly Point. The world is full of dangers. Standing shoulder to shoulder with your alliance members creates a powerful and unbreakable frontline.
4. Speak up in the Alliance Chat. Communication brings the alliance together. Whether you're sharing stories or asking for help, every message helps strengthen our connection.
5. Spend your Alliance Coins wisely. You earn Alliance Coins through donations and events. Use them to exchange for valuable items and accelerate your progress.
We wish you an exciting and rewarding journey with your alliance!
